prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Be sure you've noted all companies and industries with attention to
    a. company & industry names
    b. chemical signatures (this is VERY important)
    c. Metal extraction/refining works
    d. power stations (especially those burning extra heavy fuel oil)
    e. Steel works
    f. Alkali works
    g. Oil workings & refineries
    h. Hydraulic & gas works
    i. Chemical works
    j. Fuel & dye works
    k. Fortnightly records of the level of pollution (from readings from Chimneys)
3. Be absolutely certain of the degree of severity and if possible, use visual
    a. Yellow haze or heavy black smoke?
    b. What time period did the observation fall into?
4. Does the scale of emissions rise or fall sharply at any given time?
5. Each last point must relate back to the first in writing
